source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보팩에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The user authorized independent randomized complex reference-guided keyword tests. This arm selects a rooftop printmaking material-comparison pause with a rising lantern, independently drawn from general-knowledge lists. The viewer is close enough to read small current facial movements and tactile material states while the studio event and city remain legible. Pouty lips is tested as current gentle forward lip action rather than increased intrinsic lip volume; side-eye is tested as lateral eye direction rather than judgment; smooth applies separately to a textured-even cheek surface and polished porcelain; supple applies to a leather pouch rim that visibly bends now, without a recovery claim. Subtle everyday attraction is a supporting quality in the close viewing relationship, soft teal drape and reflected skin light. The scene remains ordinarily physical with restrained creative variation.

The small forward mouth action is visible as compact lip protrusion, independently of natural lip volume.
Fine natural texture remains on an even cheek surface, distinct from the polished smoothness of the porcelain oval.

baseline_prompt_en: Photograph an explicitly adult 29-year-old woman in a rooftop printmaking studio above a city market. A paper lantern rises on a taut pulley cord beside a print drying rack, its tassel making a short upward blur above the hanging sheets. She stands beside the waist-high print table, pausing with a palm-sized porcelain oval and a thin dark leather map pouch. Use the supplied portrait's visible facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe as the face-and-hair appearance reference. Her eyes and natural upper-and-lower lip contours retain their reference proportions. Her head stays nearly frontal while both irises turn toward the lantern at her anatomical left, on screen right. Both lips are gently drawn forward into a small compact rounded opening, with softly resting mouth corners. Her cheek surfaces have even soft light transitions and visible fine natural skin texture. Her left hand steadies the pouch against the waist-high print table; her left thumb presses its rim inward into a rounded bend and broad soft folds. Her right palm supports the porcelain oval at chest height, with curled fingers beneath it. The oval has a continuous polished glaze and an even reflected highlight. A muted teal wrap blouse drapes softly across her collarbone. Compose a vertical medium close environmental photograph at eye level, keeping her face, mouth, eyes and both held materials clear at native detail; place the pouch and oval near the same depth plane as her face. Bright midday light passes through a translucent ceiling, with faint rooftop geometry and market awnings beyond the rail. The moment feels quietly attentive, intimate in viewing distance, and tactile, with the moving paper form answering the soft fold below.
